== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Elaina is a character identified in connection to [[Vasha]]. While specific details regarding her background or abilities are not fully detailed, she is mentioned in a context involving the strength of [[Vasha]]'s father.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Elaina possesses short blond hair and pale skin. She also has eyes that resemble those of her father.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Elaina is the daughter of [[Indirial]], characterized by her short blond hair and pale skin. She possesses her father's eyes and was once held captive within a cage. This confinement took the form of a dangling cage during her imprisonment.}}
